prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic high-fashion photograph of an original adult woman posing in a vintage luxury elevator with dark-green velvet walls and polished wood trim. She wears a pale-pink crystal-embellished long-sleeve column gown with a modest bateau neckline that sparkles under soft warm lighting, and carries a matching crystal-beaded bucket bag. She stands in side profile near an ornate gold-framed mirror, one hand gently near her cheek, looking toward the camera with a calm soft expression. The mirror reflects the gown and warm elevator interior; the floor is muted green patterned carpet. Capture a glamorous moody nostalgic editorial with detailed beadwork, natural skin, slight film grain, and soft-focus highlights.
